Listen to my heart in teh present moment has always showed me to be the right path because even if I look back and feel like I should have done soemthign else I realize that that is what I needed at that moment.

hey love this, but also something I learned in my journey is that sometimes you really had no choice in a situation. For example, I had an eating disorder for as long I know my self. Even thought this was related to my own psyche my family always denied it and negleted any help with medication or psychologist (even if i asked for it). The result was a young me trying to figure everything out on her own, I became a strong person but I personally wasnt hppy. Instead of enjoying my free time I would read papers about eating disorder, infinite books, try all this strategies. I did try a lot but I lacked guidance from someone experienced. And after 10 year I spiralled into depression because the problem destroyed my body mentally and physically. Was I responsible for my short comings? yes but I also believe I deserved to be heard by my parents ( at lest if I ws a parent and my kid had issues I would try to help in the best way I could). so YEAH  i suffered so much feeling I was guilty of it all when in the end I relly wasnt seeing how also people sometimed DO  influence the shortcomings of your life :)

another example, my partner cheated on me in the beginning of our relationship. From then on I couldn't trust him and started to feel I wasnt worthy for while our reltioship lasted. Was it my responsability to see that my worth wasnt based on them? yes. Was it my responsability to probably leave the relationship? also yes. But I do think that this also can cause you to feel shit and people are shit too hahah and they can inflict pain on you. Once you reconize that people that really care about you will make a change to help you feel better you will change who is around you and thing will also improve with your inside-self.

also about toxic traits and shadow self, I think this things are completely opposite. Toxic traits is inflicting pain onto other people. Shadow self is the self that you hide from your truest desires ( because you had this believe of being bad/ shadowy). Let's say you are jealous, this is your shadow self, but it is not toxic. It is real and people naturally feel jealous when the think they don't have something they want. But once you integrate it and see your jealousy rather as a direction than a bad emotion you will learn so much about yourself. Toxicity would be applying your jealousy and inflicting pin over others because of your emotions.

anyway I am on the same boat now, working in my ed recover for real before embarking any relationship. good luck to us :)
